description: Estimate a UK CIS subcontractor's tax refund (or amount to pay) for tax year 2025-26, 2026-27 or 2027-28 (Budget 2026 rules for 2027-28). Takes the year's gross CIS income, the CIS deducted (the statement total, or the 20%/30% rate), allowable expenses (materials, tools, van mileage at HMRC simplified rates, parking and travel, phone, protective clothing, training and site cards, insurance, accountant) and optional other PAYE/pension income. Calculates taxable profit (or the trading allowance if better: £1,000, or £3,000 from 2027-28), income tax (England/Wales/NI or Scottish bands, Personal Allowance taper), Class 4 NIC and the Class 2 position, then compares the bill with the CIS already deducted. Returns the working line by line, payments-on-account warning, commonly missed expenses, rates used with GOV.UK sources and a result card. For self-employed sole traders under CIS, not limited companies. Read-only: stores and sends nothing. An estimate, not tax advice.

accountancy_other_gbp.description: Accountant fees, business bank charges, trade subscriptions, stationery. Default 0.

business_miles.description: Business miles driven in own van/car (between sites, to merchants). Claimed at HMRC flat rates: 45p (2025-26) or 55p (2026-27 on) for the first 10,000; 25p after (35p from 2027-28, Budget 2026); 24p motorcycles. Default 0.

cis_deducted_gbp.description: Total CIS deducted in the year, from the monthly CIS payment and deduction statements, GBP. If omitted it is worked out from cis_rate on the labour part.

cis_rate.description: Deduction rate used when cis_deducted_gbp is not given: '20' (registered for CIS) or '30' (not registered). Default '20'.

gross_cis_income_gbp.description: Total paid by contractors in the tax year BEFORE CIS deductions (labour plus any materials invoiced), GBP. Required.

insurance_gbp.description: Public liability and tool insurance. Default 0.

materials_gbp.description: Cost of materials the subcontractor bought and invoiced to contractors (CIS is not deducted from these; they are an expense). Default 0.

other_expenses_gbp.description: Any other allowable business expenses. Default 0.

other_income_gbp.description: Other taxable income in the same year from a PAYE job or pension (gross), GBP. Default 0.

parking_tolls_travel_gbp.description: Parking, tolls, congestion/ULEZ charges for work trips, public transport and work-away accommodation. Default 0.

phone_internet_gbp.description: Business share of phone and data. Default 0.

region.description: Where the person lives for income tax: 'england_wales_ni' or 'scotland' (Scottish bands). Default england_wales_ni.

tax_paid_on_other_income_gbp.description: Income tax already paid on that other income (from the P60/P45). Default 0.

tax_year.description: UK tax year: '2025-26' (6 Apr 2025 to 5 Apr 2026, return due 31 Jan 2027), '2026-27' or '2027-28' (Budget 2026 rules; Scottish 2027-28 bands not yet set, 2026-27 ones used). Default '2025-26'.

tools_equipment_gbp.description: Tools and equipment bought for work in the year. Default 0.

training_cards_gbp.description: CSCS/CPCS cards and training that updates existing trade skills. Default 0.

vehicle_costs_gbp.description: Business share of actual van/car costs, ONLY if not using mileage for that vehicle. Default 0.

workwear_ppe_gbp.description: Protective clothing, PPE and branded workwear (not everyday clothes). Default 0.

description: List the UK rates a self-employed CIS subcontractor's tax bill uses for 2025-26, 2026-27 or 2027-28, each with its GOV.UK source: Personal Allowance and taper, income tax bands (England/Wales/NI or Scotland), Class 4 NIC limits and rates, the Class 2 position (treated as paid above the Small Profits Threshold, voluntary below), HMRC simplified mileage rates, the trading allowance (£1,000; £3,000 from 2027-28), the Making Tax Digital start dates and the 20%/30% CIS deduction rates. Read-only. Not tax advice.
